title: tools.json
description: One object per tool, reference evaluation or benchmarked program. id is the join key used by capabilities.csv, conventions.json, findings.json and benchmarks/results.csv.

library.description: The implementation the tool belongs to: the id of the tool record whose own library is itself. Front ends over one implementation (an R and a Python interface to one C core, a translation of one toolbox, a parallel backend over a library's own algorithm code) share it, and every count of tools offering a measure counts libraries, so each implementation is counted once.

role.description: checked: run and compared; documented-only: capabilities taken from documentation, never run; benchmarked-only: appears only in the benchmark data; reference: evaluation of the published definition.
